note: The direction is in CLAUDE.md (a design tool's interface, Heroicons, neutral greys, one blue accent) and n_bz8p; no design document of its own.
Every color is a token written as light-dark(), with tint and shade for surfaces.
One font (Inter), but sizes are raw pixels per element: 10, 10.5, 11, 11.5, 12, 12.5, 13 and 15 px.
Tailwind's default spacing is used throughout; nothing decided beyond it.
Tailwind's rounded and shadow classes with shade tints, chosen per element.
Menus and cards share classes in style.css; the rest is markup repeated in one large index.html.
Heroicons, inlined, for tools and panel actions; words for content.
A design tool's interface (Figma UI3) is named as the reference; no reference set kept in the project.
About 20 aria labels and tooltips; no stated baseline since n_mcjp put it aside while the tool was internal.
